Common Data For Q.4 and 5: 
A joint sample space for two random variables X and Y has 
four elements (1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3) and (4, 4). Probabilities 
of these elements are 0.1, 0.35, 0.05 and 0.5 respectively. 
4.
The probability of the event {X ≤ 2.5, Y ≤ 6} is
(a) 0.45
(b) 0.50
(c) 0.55
(d) 0.60
5.
The probability of the event {X ≤ 3} is
(a) 0.45
(b) 0.50
(c) 0.55
(d) 0.60
